title: Verify path boundaries
acceptance:
Story: the 0.1 boundary promise survives the richer path model.
Expected: traversal, encoded traversal, hard links and junctions are refused, and one member can never address another member's home.
Not expected: quarantine or antivirus behaviour; refusal is enough.
Depends on: WI-16 path handling.
Verify: tests and acceptance exercise traversal, links and cross-home attempts.
evidence: Traversal, encoded traversal, hard links and junctions answer 404, and a second member cannot read another home (node test, verify.py and the independent QA replay).
